title: ForkMesh mirror Actions runtime lease
description: Short-lived, owner-local executor state read by the headless mirror catalog publisher. This document is never a workflow, command, variable, log, or source of authorization.

updatedAt.description: UTC Unix time in milliseconds. Runtime policy requires it to be fresh and within the bounded lease horizon.

expiresAt.description: UTC Unix time in milliseconds. Runtime policy requires it to be in the future and no more than 15 minutes ahead.
